summary: Assignments to retired groups are stopped at Commit, and workload readiness is reported honestly.

fixes.title: Assignments to retired groups are refused
fixes.text: Committing an assignment to a retired or undefined group is refused, with the row and two ways out. A group cannot be retired while assignments still name it.

fixes.title: Power BI prerequisite checks itself
fixes.text: The Power BI prerequisite names the group and the identity that must be in it, and checks the membership itself.

fixes.title: Unreadable workloads are not ready
fixes.text: A workload PIM Manager could not read is never counted as ready.
